periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Near-vertical orientation with a slight medial tilt at the inferior pole of both patches.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertically elongated ovoid shape with a height-to-width ratio of approximately 1.7:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering where the inferior tip extends significantly further from the ocular center than the superior margin.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped curve along the posterior margin of the band.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Broad transverse band occupying approximately 30 percent of the visible longitudinal torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation across the cranial vault, approximately 1.5 to 2 times the width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Uniformly rounded semicircular profile at the superior apex of both ears.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant dark saturation and matting of the fur on the hindquarters and lower ventral region, consistent with moisture exposure.
